note: All 10 samas are fully populated and sourced. Original owi text and Marathi meaning from the ioustotra.blogspot.com 'Stotra (hymns)' blog (Prakash Ketkar); English meaning from John Norwell's 2015 translation. Every samas's owi count matches exactly between both independent sources with no gaps, duplicates, or numbering shifts. Samas 3 and 4 each contain owi-groups whose Marathi meaning is a single combined explanation for several consecutive owis - see each samas's own note.

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Moorkha Lakshan (The Characteristics of the Fool)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ॐ नमोजि गजानना । येकदंता त्रिनयना । कृपादृष्टी भक्तजना । अवलोकावें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक दांत व तीन डोळे आहेत अश्या ॐकाररुप गजाननाला मी नमस्कार करतो आणि प्रार्थना करतो की, आपल्या या भक्ताकडे कृपादृष्टीने पाहावे.
owis.englishMeaning: aum (`I am'), I bow down to you, lord ganesh. The God with one tusk (knowledge) and three eyes (the third eye is the eye of knowledge). Grant your devotee in this world, your vision of understanding.

owis.original: तुज नमूं वेदमाते । श्रीशारदे ब्रह्मसुते । अंतरीं वसे कृपावंते । स्फूर्तिरुपें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मदेवाची कन्या व वेदांची माता अश्या शारदेला नमन करुन तीने स्फूर्तिरुपाने माझ्या अंतरी विराजमान होण्याची माझ्यावर कृपा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: I bow down to you, oh mother of the vedas (knowledge), goddess sharada, the daughter of brahman. For the one who has received your *grace/krupa, you reside in this inner space in the form of the inspiration `I am'. *(In the yoga vasistha it is said, nothing is achieved without self-effort; maharaj- do and see for yourself:)

owis.original: वंदून सद्गुरुचरण । करुन रघुनाथस्मरण । त्यागार्थ मूर्खलक्षण बोलिजेल ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आता माझ्या सद्गुरुंच्या चरणांना वंदन करुन माझे स्वामी रघुनातहांचेही स्मरण करतो व मूर्खांची लक्षणें सांगतो. त्यांचा (सूज्ञाने) त्याग करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: And when one goes to and surrenders at the feet of sadguru then, there is the remem- bering of ram. This is the meaning of *renunciation. Therefore the attention of the fool should be made into this `speech'. *(This `speech' is the remembering of ram and it the renouncing of the gross body. It is the giving up of dreams, hopes and memories and it is the listening to and seeing of this endless `now' within us. This ever present moment is all we have, it is our essence and yet we let it slip away behind childish imaginings).

owis.original: येक मूर्ख येक पढत मूर्ख । उभय लक्षणीं कौतुक । श्रोती सादर विवेक । केला पाहिंजे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूर्खांचे दोन प्रकार आहेत. एक मूर्ख व दुसरा पढत मूर्ख त्यांची लक्षणें ऐकून श्रोत्यांना कौतुक वाटेल. त्यांचा (लक्षणांचा त्यागार्थ) विचार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: That One has become a fool and that One has become a knowledgeable fool. Yet within both of these attentions there is this wonder of this `speech'. Therefore, in the listener there should be thoughtful vivek (the mind of the listener should become subtle leaving of gross thoughts, to hear this silent `speech').

owis.original: पढतमूर्खाचें लक्षण । पुढिले समासीं निरुपण । सावध होऊनि विचक्षण । परिसोत पुढें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पढत मूर्खाची लक्षणे पुढिल्या अध्यायी (दहाव्या समासांत) सांगितली आहेत. शहाण्या श्रोत्यांनी ती लक्ष देऊन ऐकावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the attention of the knowledgeable fool, if this silent discourse `I am' within the composition of words has been understood but not maintained (maharaj- the knowled- geable fool is one who has come to the Master and has not accepted the understanding fully). However if you remain alert and listen with great care, then there is this `speech' ahead (therefore you should not fall back again into the compositions of words and be a knowledgeable fool, but you should remain in this `I am' understanding by not creating the thoughts of that which is not)

owis.original: आतां प्रस्तुत विचार । लक्षणें सांगतां अपार । परी कांहीयेक तत्पर । होऊन ऐका ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आता मूर्ख लक्षणें जी पुष्कळ आहेत त्यापैकी काहीं सांगतो. ती तत्परतेने ऐकावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless understanding is being prepared when now there is this thought `I am' and then, due to this attention, there comes that attentionless, limitless paramatma. Therefore listen and then that One who is within everyone, will be absorbed in this `I am' feeling.

owis.original: जे प्रपंचिक जन । जयांस नाहीं आत्मज्ञान । जे केवळ अज्ञान त्यांचीं लक्षणें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मज्ञान नसलेले व म्हणून अज्ञानी आणि प्रपंचांतच अडकलेले त्यांची लक्षणें सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But when mula maya has thoughts of this mundane existence then, it cannot become that knowledge of atma. Therefore understand this mula maya, for it is due to this attention of that atma that this ignorance of mula maya becomes that attentionless pure knowledge (when all thoughts are subdued then, there is this effortless knowing of mula maya. And by means of this sagun, one becomes nirgun; by constantly remaining in this `I am', it goes off of its own accord and Reality remains).

owis.original: जन्मला जयांचें उदरीं । तयांसी जो विरोध करी । सखी मानिली अंतुरी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या आई-वडिलांस न मानणारा, त्यांचे न ऐकणारा व केवळ पत्नी हीच सखी असे मानणारा तो एक मूर्ख आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But when this mula maya takes birth in a womb then, that atma purush opposes its own Reality and says, "I am someone". Then he respects his wife as his confidant (and not His prakruti) and that One atma has become a fool.

owis.original: सांडून सर्वहि गोत । स्त्रीआधेन जीवित । सांगे अंतरींची मात । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या नातेवाईकांना दूर ठेवून बायकोजवळच अंतरीचे बोलणारा असा बाईलबुद्ध्या तो एक मूर्ख आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma leaves aside this meeting place of the `all' (prakruti) and lives as a dependent (an individual body) of prakruti then, that glorious and pure thoughtless understanding has become the `many' affairs and thoughts of this mundane world and that One atma has become a fool.

owis.original: परस्त्रीसीं प्रेमा धरी । श्र्वशुरगृहीं वास करी । कुळेंविण कन्या वरी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परस्त्रीवर प्रेम करणारा, सासुरवाडीस राहणारा व एखाद्या मुलीशी कुलाशीलाचा विचार न करता लग्न करणारा असा तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma has love for another woman (and not His own woman ie. pra- kruti/creation; He has accepted body consciousness and then loves another); when He stays in the father-in-law's house and not in His own place and when He marries a wife other than prakruti then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: समर्थावरी अहंता । अंतरीं मानी समता । सामर्थेंविण करी सत्ता । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्येष्ठ व श्रेष्ठ लोकांशी अहंकाराने ते व आपण बरोबरीचेच आहोत असे मानून अधिकार नसता सत्ता गाजवितो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma places the ahamta ("I am a body" ego) upon its non-duality and believes that they are both the same; when He has this power of ahamta that is devoid of real power then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: आपली आपण करी स्तुती । स्वदेशीं भोगी विपत्ति । सांगे वडिलांची कीर्ती । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपली आपणच स्तुती करतो. स्वदेशी विपत्तींत असतो. वडिलांची कीर्ती ऐकवून खोटा मोठेपणाचा आव आणतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If that atma praises itself then, though being in His own state, He will suffer great misfortune (though being One, ever present and unaware even of Himself, He falls down into body consciousness and says, "I am so great, I have done this etc."). Then this `all'-pervading and whole atma is a fool.

owis.original: अकारण हास्य करी । विवेक सांगतां न धरी । जो बहुतांचा वैरी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कारण नसतां हसतो. योग्य विचार, सल्ला ऐकत नाही. पुष्कळ लोकांशी वैर धरतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If that atma laughs at the causeless swarup; if through vivek He does not hold that thoughtless understanding; if that purush is an enemy of this `all' then, that One atma has become a fool (the purush should be the dearest and nearest friend of this `all').

owis.original: आपुलीं धरुनियां दुरी । पराव्यासीं करी मीत्री । परन्यून बोले रात्रीं । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या (नातेवाईकांशी) दुरावा व परकीयांशी घरोबा व दुसर्‍याचे उणे बोलतो. असा तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If that atma keeps His own beloved Self far away and makes friendship with the fore- igner/stranger (ie. body ego) then, its `speech' is strange and defective (full of opinions and fears etc.) and in this night of ignorance that One atma has become a fool.

owis.original: बहुत जागते जन । तयांमध्यें करी शयन । परस्थळीं बहु भोजन । करी तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळजण जागत असतांना हा मध्येच पसरतो (झोपतो). दुसर्‍या ठिकाणी फार जेवतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `all' has awakened the mind and though being in that Reality it falls again asleep; if being in this foreign place, it enjoys the `many' fruits of the past actions, then that One atma has become a fool. (This world is not our home; here we take ourselves as a body and suffer and enjoy the results of past actions and taking ourself as a body we make new actions in the hope of an enjoyable outcome. This `all', on the other hand, lets these fruits of past actions appear without holding or rejecting and in this way also, does not create any further karma)

owis.original: मान अथवा अपमान । स्वयें करी परिछिन्न । सप्त वेसनी जयाचें मन । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मान किंवा अपमान आपला आपण उघड करतो. सात प्रकारच्या व्यसनाधीन मनाचा असतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma, of its own accord, makes a difference between praise and insult; when the mind of that mula maya is addicted to so many things then, that One atma is a fool. (The mind of mula maya is the universal mind, `I am He')

owis.original: धरुन परावी आस । प्रेत्न सांडी सावकास । निसुगाईचा संतोष । मानी तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आळशी, कामांत प्रयत्न करण्याची दिरंगाई करतो. काही न करण्यात आनंद मानणारा असतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma holds hope for that which is not His own and belongs to another (ie. the body and mind) and makes efforts leaving the `effortless' aside; when He gets satisfaction from being *lazy then, that One is a fool. *(siddharameshwar maharaj- laziness means body intellect/buddhi)

owis.original: घरीं विवेक उमजे । आणी सभेमध्यें लाजे । शब्द बोलतां निर्बुजे । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घरांमध्ये शहाणपणाने विचाराने बोलणारा (शहाण्यांच्या) सभेंत मात्र बुजणारा व तोंडून शब्द फुटत नाही असा असतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma understands vivek in the house (ie. body) and is ashamed to use it in the meeting place (one may understand this vivek when sitting alone, letting whatever has to come, come without holding on or rejection but is afraid to use such vivek all the time in the world; one is afraid to leave this small pervasiveness of the body and let one's pervasiveness become as vast as the world. One has to stop seeing, as it were, with the senses and allow oneself to be everywhere); when that is afraid to `speak' this original `word' then, that One is a fool (maharaj- you fear of what the people will say).

owis.original: आपणाहून जो श्रेष्ठ । तयासीं अत्यंत निकट । सिकवणेचा मानी वीट । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्यापेक्षा श्रेष्ठ असणाराशी जवळीक करतो. कोणी काहीं हिताचे सांगू लागला तर कंटाळा करतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That witnessing purush is greater than you and so very close to the Reality; but when He feels too weary to study, `Who am I?' then, that One has become a fool.

owis.original: नायेके त्यांसी सिकवी । वडिलांसीं जाणीव दावी । जो आरजास गोवी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जे ऐकत नाहीत त्यांना शिकवायला जातो. मोठ्या माणसांपुढे शहाणपणा मिरवतो. चांगल्याला भानगडींत अडकवतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you teach the Master and display your knowing ("I know such and such") to that atma; when that noble atma purush gets embarrassed and entangled in body consciousness then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: येकायेकीं येकसरा । जाला विषंई निलाजिरा । मर्यादा सांडून सैरा । वर्ते तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विषयवासना भोगापायीं मर्यादा सोडून निलाजरा होतो आणि उद्दामपणे वागतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you shamelessly and continually *become the sense objects; when you leave off all restraint and live like a thief (maharaj- mind is a thief) then, that One atma is a fool. *(maharaj- `when you see a ice-cream, you become the ice-cream'; your consciousness takes the form of the object it perceives)

owis.original: औषध ने घे असोन वेथा । पथ्य न करी सर्वथा । न मिळे आलिया पदार्था । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: व्याधी, व्यथेने पिडित असूनही औषध घेत नाही. पथ्य पाळीत नाही. वाट्यास जे आले ते स्वीकारत नाही. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you suffer and do not accept the remedy of this `all' and when you do not always follow the path of understanding; and when you do not merge in this `all' that has been brought then, that One atma is a fool (ie. though one has understood that by forgetting everything this `all' is perceived still, this understanding is not maintained).

owis.original: संगेंविण विदेश करी । वोळखीविण संग धरी । उडी घाली माहापुरीं । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सोबत कोणाची नसता विदेशी जातो. ओळख-पाळख नसतां मैत्री करतो. महापुरांत उडी मारतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you go to this foreign place without the company of the atma and keep the company of that which you do not recognize and so throw yourself in this great flood of worldly life then, that One atma has become a fool.

owis.original: आपणास जेथें मान । तेथें अखंड करी गमन । रक्षूं नेणे मानाभिमान । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेथे लोक मान देतात तेथे वारंवार जातो. स्वतःचा मान व योग्य गोष्टीचा अभिमान धरत नाही. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you respect yourself `here' (in maya) then, that unbroken `there' (in brahman) spends its time uselessly; when you accept and protect the ego of honour then, that One atma has become a fool.

owis.original: सेवक जाला लक्ष्मीवंत । तयाचा होय अंकित । सर्वकाळ जो दुश्र्चित्त । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला नोकर श्रीमंत झाला तर त्याचा गुलाम होतो. ज्याचे चित्त नेहमी अस्थिर असते. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When That which *possesses this wealth of lakshmi (`I am the whole creation') becomes a servant; when that Reality becomes a slave of the mind; when that purush, being within this time of the `all', forgets its own Self and becomes a body then, that One is a fool. *(narayan/Self is the spouse of lakshmi)

owis.original: विचार न करितां कारण । दंड करी अपराधेंविण । स्वल्पासाठीं जो कृपण । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्याचा काहीं अपराध नसतांना सारासार विचार न करता त्यास शिक्षा करतो. थोड्या त्यागासाठी (खर्चासाठी) कंजूषपणा करतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the understanding, I do not exist, is not made then, you are punishing the One who has no fault; when on account of this very small *maya that witnessing purush becomes a miser ("I need this and that") then, that One is a fool. *(maya is like a small cloud appearing in the vastness of the sky; just a tiny thought appearing upon the thoughtless)

owis.original: देवलंड पितृलंड । शक्तिवीण करी तोड । ज्याचे मुखीं भंडउभंड । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाची वा वडिलधार्‍यांची तमा बाळगत नाही. बळहीन, शक्तिहीन, ज्ञानहीन असूनही तोंडाळपणा करतो. वाटेल तसे बरळत असतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you deceive God then, you deceive your Father and do not have this power `I am He' on your lips; when you always argue with this prakruti that stands before the Witness then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: घरीच्यावरी खाय दाढा । बाहेरी दीन बापुडा । ऐसा जो कां वेड मूढा । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घरांतील माणसांवर दांत-ओठ काढतो, बाहेरच्याशीं मात्र बापुडवाणेपणाने वागतो. असा अज्ञानी व वेडा एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you are bold in your own `house' but distressed and pitiable outside (the ego takes itself to be so great and yet it feels so small when it looks up at the vastness of space; though, in truth, you pervade this whole space even); when that atma is dull and mad for objects then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: नीच यातीसीं सांगात । परांगनेसीं येकांत । मार्गें जाय खात खात । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नीच, हलक्या लोकांशी संगत करतो. दुसर्‍याच्या बायकोशी रत होतो. रस्त्याने खातखात जातो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you keep company with the lowly caste body and stay alone with the wandering and distressed mind; when you destroy the way to liberation and reduce it to shit then, that One is a fool. (maharaj- this body is a shit factory)

owis.original: स्वयें नेणे परोपकार । उपकाराचा अनोपकार । करी थोडें बोले फार । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण कोणावरही उपकार करत नाही. दुसर्‍याने आपल्यावर केलेल्या उपकाराची फेड अपकाराने करतो. काम कमी करतो पण अफाट बोलतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you, by self-willfulness, remove That which is our greatest benefit and if you are ungrateful of this great favour that it has been given (`I am'-ness/life); if you make this great `speech' small then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: तपीळ खादाड आळसी । कुश्र्चीळ कुटीळ मानसीं । धारीष्ट नाहीं जयापासीं । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तापट, खादाड, आळशी, वाईट वर्तुणुकीचा, कपटी मनाचा आणि धैर्यहीन असा तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma is angry, voracious and lazy; when That is impure and malicious in the mind; when that mula purush has no courage and forbearance when with His mula maya then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: विद्या वैभव ना धन । पुरुषार्थ सामर्थ्य ना मान । कोरडाच वाहे अभिमान । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विद्या, ज्ञान, धन, पैसा, पुरुषार्थ, सामर्थ्य नसूनही अभिमान बाळगतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: To have the knowledge that has neither real grandeur nor true wealth; to have no respect for this power (knowledge) and the essence of your existence (non- duality); when that worships this empty ego then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: लंडी लटिका लाबाड । कुकर्मी कुटीळ निचाड । निद्रा जयाची वाड । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खोटा, दुराचारी, लबाड, उद्धट, वाईट कामे करणारा, वाईट बुद्धीचा व बेशरम असून फार झोपा काढतो,  तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that is a coward and bastard son of the false; when His vastness has been made small by impure actions, deception and improper boldness; when this pervasiveness of mula maya sleeps in body consciousness then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: उंचीं जाऊन वस्त्र नेसे । चौबारां बाहेरी बैसे । सर्वकाळ नग्न दिसे । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो उंच जागी जाऊन कपडे घालतो. उकीरड्यावर परसाकडे बसतो. बहुतेक नेहमी नग्न किंवा कमी कपडे घालतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Being in that paramatma he wears this disguise of a body and takes delight in the pleasures outside; though being in this *time of the `all' he appears naked and destitute; then that One is a fool. *(To be in the now, without thought of past or future or "Am I or am I not?")

owis.original: दंत चक्षु आणी घ्राण । पाणी वसन आणी चरण । सर्वकाळ जयाचे मळिण । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याचे दांत, डोळे, नाक, हात-पाय व कपडे नेहमी ज्याचे मळलेले असतात. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then with teeth, eyes, nose and hands; with clothes and feet, he has spoiled His time in this `all' (though being that One without parts, He takes himself to be a body of many parts); that One is a fool.

owis.original: वैधृति आणी वितिपात । नानाकुमुहूर्तें जात । अपशकुनें करी घात । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वैधृति, व्यतिपात अशा वाईट मुहूर्तांवर प्रवास करतो. अपशकून करुन दुसर्‍याचा घात करतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that one believes in omens and portents and travels on the deviating path of the `many'; when due to such beliefs one becomes a killer (though being eternal, one accepts the body of the jiva and then kills your own atma/Self) then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: क्रोधें अपमानें कुबुद्धि । आपणास आपण वधी । जयास नाहीं दृढ बुद्धि । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार राग, अपमान सहन न होऊन स्वतःचा आत्मघात करतो. ज्याला स्थिर बुद्धी नसते, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When out of anger, disrespect and a dull intellect, you kill yourself (when "I am a body" kills the thought `I am He'); when one's conviction is not towards mula maya then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: जिवलगांस परम खेदी । सुखाचा शब्द तोहि नेदी । नीच जनास वंदी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जिवलग लोकांना अति दुःख देतो. त्यांना सुखाचा शब्दही देत नाही. नीचांशी मात्र दबून वागतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that Supreme gives trouble to its beloved Self; when That does not give any `word' of pleasure (ie. `I am'); when That continually and constant bows down to the mind then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: आपणास राखे परोपरी । शरणागतांस अव्हेरी । लक्ष्मीचा भर्वसा धरी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या स्वतःच्या सुखांत व ते राखण्यांत तत्पर, प्रयत्नशील असतो. कोणी आश्रयास आल्यास त्याला अव्हेरतो-दूर लोटतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one always, by any means, protects oneself and disrespects this state of shelter (ie. knowledge); when one holds faith in good fortune and success then, that One purush is a fool.

owis.original: पुत्र कलत्र आणि दारा । इतुकाचि मानुनियां थारा । विसरोन गेला ईश्र्वरा । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुलगा, कुटुंब व बायको येवढ्यांनाच ओळखतो व देवासही विसरुन जातो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one believes that sons, daughters and a wife are ones only support; when one forgets and leaves ishwara (God and witnessing purush) then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: जैसें जैसें करावें । तैसें तैसें पावावें । हे जयास नेणवे । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " जसे करावे तसे मिळते ", हे ज्याला कळत नाही, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: As is one's action, so will be the result. Therefore when that thoughtless atma does not know mula maya and acts as a fool then, that One is a fool. (When you do not be the witnessing purush then, you are a fool)

owis.original: पुरुषाचेनि अष्टगुणें । स्त्रियांस ईश्र्वरी देणें । ऐशा केल्या बहुत जेणें । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्रियांची विषयवासना पुरुषांपेक्षा आठपट असते, अशा अनेक स्त्रियांशी लग्न करतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of that purush there are these eight properties of prakruti (ie. three gunas and five elements). He has given these to His woman (these gunas and elements remain unmanifest as an infinite potential and there is the witnessed and Witness) but then this `all' of mula maya creates something else from these and that One atma becomes a fool. (When they become manifest there is further objectification and the imagining of `many' names and forms)

owis.original: दुर्जनाचेनि बोलें । मर्यादा सांडून चाले । दिवसा झांकिले डोळे । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुर्जनाने सांगितल्याप्रमाणे मर्यादा सोडून वागतो व दिवसा डोळे झाकून म्हणजे ज्ञान असूनही अज्ञानी माणसासारखा (दुर्जनांच्या सांगण्यावरुन) वागतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one `speaks' with a mind that is far from the atma then, all constraint is left aside and one acts willfully; when one closes one's eyes before the sunlight (ie. understanding) then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: देवद्रोही गुरुद्रोही । मातृद्रोही पितृद्रोही । ब्रह्मद्रोही स्वामीद्रोही । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, गुरु, माता, पिता, ब्राह्मण व स्वामी यांचेशी विश्र्वासघाताने वागणारा, एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that disowns God and guru then, that disowns its Mother and Father. Then that disowns brahman and swami (the Master) and that One is a fool.

owis.original: परपीडेचें मानी सुख । परसंतोषाचें मानी दुःख । गेले वस्तूचा करी शोक । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसर्‍यास त्रास होत असेल तर याला आनंद व दुसर्‍यास सुख होत असेल तर याला दुःख होते, हरवलेल्या गोष्टींचे दुःख करतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma gets pleasure out of the suffering of another (prakruti is the other and when she and the bliss of her company is left aside then, one accepts momentary pleasures and sufferings and gives so much suffering to her); when that atma gets displeasure out of the satisfaction of another (when one feels that the joy of renunciation of this body is a painful alternative to being a body); when that atma gets sad over the things that will surely be lost then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: आदरेंविण बोलणें । न पुसतां साक्ष देणें । निंद्य वस्तु आंगिकारणें । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाचाही आदर न ठेवता बोलतो. कोणीही विचारल्याशिवाय साक्ष देतो. वाईट गोष्टी जवळ बाळगतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one does not give respect to this `speech'; when one does not wipe out that Witness (and be that One); when one accepts those things that are prohibited and does not accept that Absolute Thing then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: तुक तोडून बोले । मार्ग सांडून चाले । कुकर्मी मित्र केले । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो अनुमानावीना बोलतो, सरळ मार्गाने चालत नाही, वाईट कामे करणारांशी मैत्री करतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you `speak' after having separated from That which is most essential; when you leave the path of liberation and go astray; when you make friends with *impure actions then, that One is a fool. *(Impure action, `I am doing'; pure action, `He does')

owis.original: पत्य राखों नेणे कदा । विनोद करी सर्वदा । हासतां खिजे पेटे द्वंदा । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वतःची पत न राखू शकणारा, नेहमी थट्टामसकरींत दंग, कोणी हसला तर हातघाईवर येऊन चिडतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who cannot keep that respected atma/Self and always makes diversion and pastime; the one who laughs and gets offended by this place of opposites (you are good/bad, this is pleasurable/painful); that One is a fool.

owis.original: होड घाली अवघड । काजेंविण करी बडबड । बोलोंचि नेणे मुखजड । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अवघड पैज मारतो. कारणाशिवाय बडबड करतो. हवे असेल तेव्हां मात्र बोलत नाही. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who establishes an agreement with this impassable maya; the one who chatters away without care; the one who does not know this `speech' and talks of the gross and inanimate; that One is a fool.

owis.original: वस्त्र शास्त्र दोनी नसे । उंचे स्थळीं जाऊन बैसे । जो गोत्रजांस विस्वासे । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चांगले वस्त्र व उत्तम विद्या नसताही उच्चासनावर जाऊन बसतो. नातेवाईकांवर विश्र्वास ठेवतो. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This covering of the gross body nor the shasthras can be found in prakruti/purush (ie. knowledge) but that highest paramatma goes and sits with them; when that purush (pure and unattached) places its faith in family and relations then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: तश्करासी वोळखी सांगे । देखिली वस्तु तेची मागे । आपलें आन्हीत करी रागें । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चोराला आपली सर्व माहीती देतो. व दिसलेली वस्तू मागतो. रागामुळें स्वतःचे नुकसान करुन घेतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If that One who possesses the understanding, I do not exist, keeps friendship with the thief (ie. mind); if that One which reveals this `all', goes to the mind and begs, "Please give me some happiness" then, one loses one's own Self due to these emotions of anger etc. and that One has become a fool.

owis.original: हीन जनासीं बराबरी । बोल बोले सरोत्तरीं । वामहस्तें प्राशन करी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हलक्या लोकांशी बरोबरीने वागतो, त्यांच्याशी वादंग घालतो. डाव्या हाताने पाणी पितो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One goes along with the lowly mind and `speaks' its lowly speech; when that One is absorbed in the ways of the left-hand (tantric practice or the wrong way) then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: समर्थासीं मत्सर धरी । अलभ्य वस्तूचा हेवा करी । घरीचा घरीं करी चोरी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रेष्ठ माणसांचा मत्सर करतो, स्वतःला प्राप्त न होऊ शकणार्‍या वस्तूसाठी हेवा करतो. स्वतःच्या घरांत चोरी करतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One is jealous of non-duality (though being himself non-dual) and desires to have that Self that cannot be attained through desire; when that atma becomes a thief in the house of the house (gross body within the `all') then, that One is a fool (the mind steals little things away from this expansive knowledge).

owis.original: सांडूनियां जगदीशा । मनुष्याचा मानी भर्वसा । सार्थकेंविण वेची वयसा । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमेश्र्वराला सोडून माणसाचा भरंवसा धरतो, कांहीही सार्थक न करता आयुष्य फुकट घालवितो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One leaves aside the `Lord of the world' and puts his faith and trust in man; when that One spends his life without ever knowing the meaning of this life then, that One is a fool. (We are content to say, "We are alive" but have never enquired into just what is this thing called life)

owis.original: संसारदुःखाचेनि गुणें । देवास गाळी देणें । मैत्राचें बोले उणें । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संसारसागरांत भोगत असलेल्या दुःखासाठी देवास शिव्या देतो. मित्रांचे दोष चारचौघांत उघड करतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that one blames God for his suffering in this worldly life that have, in truth, been caused by his own gunas (God gave us the freedom to choose and look what we have done with that freedom; we have given away that pure sattwa guna and accepted the gunas of the body, sattwa, raja, tama/ignorance ie. objectification and imagination); when that one `speaks' scornfully of his only friend then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: अल्प अन्याय क्ष्मा न करी । सर्वकाळ धारकीं धरी । जो विश्र्वासघात करी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: थोड्याही चुकीसाठी माफ न करता शिक्षा करुन, चुकणारास धारेवर धरतो, स्वतःमात्र विश्र्वासघात करतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one does not forgive the small offence ("I am a body") then, one holds this time of the `all' under rigid control (by creating endless concepts we imprison the atma in the body and when control is dropped then, this `all' is there); when that purush gives up its faith then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: समर्थाचे मनींचे तुटे । जयाचेनि सभा विटे । क्षणा बरा क्षणा पालटे । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञानी श्रेष्ठ लोकांच्या मनांतून उतरतो,  सभेमध्ये नकोसा होतो, चंचळ मनाचा असतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one breaks the mind (`You are He') of the Master then, this meeting place of mula maya is spoiled; when that one is wise one moment and then turns away the next moment, then, that One atma has become a fool.

owis.original: बहुतां दिवसांचे सेवक । त्यागून ठेवी आणिक । ज्याची सभा निर्नायेक । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जुने विश्र्वासु सेवक सोडून नवीन सेवक ठेवतो, ज्याच्या सभेला सावरणाराच (अध्यक्ष) कोणी नसतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: It is this `all' that has been serving you all your days and yet, you have abandoned this treasure for something else; then this meeting place of that witnessing purush is in anarchy and that One atma is a fool.

owis.original: अनीतीनें द्रव्य जोडी । धर्म नीती न्याय सोडी । संगतीचें मनुष्य तोडी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ५९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भ्रष्ट मार्गाने पैसा मिळवतो, धर्म, नीति, न्यायाने वागत नाही, बरोबर राहणार्‍या लोकांना तोडतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one takes the wealth of gross manifestation (objectification) through injustice ("I am a body") and leaves the *dharma of justice (`I am eternal'); when that one breaks this company then, He becomes a man and that One atma has become a fool. *(inherent nature)

owis.original: घरीं असोन सुंदरी । जो सदांचा परद्वारी । बहुतांचें उचिष्ट अंगीकारीं । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घरी सुंदर स्त्री असूनही जो बाहेरख्यालीपणा करतो, पुष्कळ लोकांचे उष्टे खातो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Though that eternal purush has this most beautiful wife within His house, that stays in the doorway of another woman (becomes a man); then that accepts the leftovers from this `all' and that One is a fool.

owis.original: आपुलें अर्थ दुसर्‍यापासीं । आणी दुसर्‍याचें अभिळासी । पर्वत करी हीनासी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला पैसा दुसर्‍यापाशी ठेवून दुसर्‍याच्या पैशाची इच्छा धरणारा, हलक्या लोकांशी पैशाचे व्यवहार करतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you give your own wealth away to prakruti and then covet this wealth of hers (first you forget yourself and take this reflection `I am' as you and then...); and if you make business with the lowly body then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: अतिताचा अंत पाहे । कुश्रामामधें राहे । सर्वकाळ चिंता वाहे । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आलेल्या पाहुण्यास मदत करत नाही, वाईट वस्तीच्या गावांत राहतो, नेहमी चिंताग्रस्त असतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one tries their uttermost to harass the uninvited guest (maharaj- `knowledge is the uninvited guest': it need not be invited, for it is always there. You just need to drop the thoughts) and stays in the village of the lowly; when one is worried though being in this time of the `all' then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: दोघे बोलत असती जेथें । तिसरा जाऊन बैसे तेथें । डोई खाजवी दोहीं हातें । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दोघेजण काहीं बोलत असता न बोलाविता तेथे जाऊन बसतो, दोन्ही हातांनी डोके खाजवितो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush and prakruti are `speaking' together `here' and a third (ie. ego) comes and sits in between; when he provokes and teases these two, then that One is a fool.

owis.original: उदकांमधें सांडी गुरळी । पायें पायें कांडोळी । सेवा करी हीन कुळीं । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जलाशयांत चूळ टाकतो, पायाने पाय खाजवितो, नीच लोकांकडे नोकरी करतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that one spits out this pure water of understanding and scratches one leg with the other (takes oneself to be a body made of `many' parts); when that one serves this lowly family then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: स्त्री बाळका सलगी देणें । पिशाच्या सन्निध बैसणें । मर्यादेविण पाळी सुणें । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बायको व मुलाशी बरोबरीने वागतो, भुताच्या जवळ बसतो, शिस्तीशिवाय कुत्रें पाळतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If one is intimate with the woman and her child (the `all' and the mind or gross world); if one sits with the mad (tukaram- this world is a mad house full of mad people); if one keeps the dog but cannot control it (the mind is like a dog, it is always wanting or sleeping) then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: परस्त्रीसी कळह करी । सुकी वस्तु निघातें मारी । मूर्खाची संगती धरी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो परस्त्रीशी भांडण करतो, मुक्या प्राण्यांना शस्त्राने मारतो, मूर्खांच्या संगतींत राहतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One quarrels with another woman (becomes a man and quarrels with his wife) it leaves that silent Self and beats it to death; when that One keeps the company of a fool then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: कळह पाहात उभा राहे । तोडविना कौतुक पाहे । खरें अस्तां खोटें साहे । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाचे भांडण पहात उभा राहतो, ते न सोडविता गंमत बघत उभा राहतो, खरे असेल ते सोडून खोटें सहन करतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One remains watching this quarrel and does not try to break up that relationship and understand this wonder of `I am'; when that One destroys the Truth and accepts the false then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: लक्ष्मी आलियावरी । जो मागील वोळखी न धरी । देवीं ब्राह्मणीं सत्ता करी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पैसा, संपत्ती आल्यावर ओळख दाखवत नाही, देवब्राह्मणांवर सत्ता गाजवितो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When one only goes as far as lakshmi (`I am') and does not recognize and keep that One who is behind her (narayana, I do not exist); when one creates one's own authority within this authority of God and the brahmin (ie. one who knows brahman) then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: आपलें काज होये तंवरी । बहुसाल नम्रता धरी । पुढिलांचें कार्य न करी । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ६९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपले काम असेल तोवर नम्रतेने वागतो, दुसर्‍यांचे (त्याचेकडे असलेले) काम मात्र करीत नाही. तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If the mind remains humble only for as long as it desires and then afterwards does not make this action of the `all' (ie. wavering mind) then, that One is a fool (in the `many').

owis.original: अक्षरें गाळून वाची । कां तें घाली पदरिचीं । नीघा न करी पुस्तकाची । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ७० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाचन करीत असतांना कांही भाग सोडून देतो किंवा स्वतःची वाक्यें मधे घालतो, पुस्तकांची निगा राखत नाही, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that indestructible atma leaves aside this `speech' then, this story `I am' is added to and embellished upon and the mind begins to tell many of its own stories; when that one cannot cast off these stories then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: आपण वाचीना कधीं । कोणास वाचावया नेदी । बांधोन ठेवी बंदीं । तो येक मूर्ख ॥ ७१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण कधी वाचत नाही व दुसर्‍यासही वाचावयास देत नाही, पुस्तके नुसती बांधुन ठेवतो, तो एक मूर्ख असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One never `speaks' Himself and does not allow this `all' to `speak'; when that One binds up and imprisons this treasure then, that One is a fool.

owis.original: ऐसीं हें मूर्खलक्षणें । श्रवणें चातुर्य बाणे । चित्त देउनियां शहाणे । ऐकती सदा ॥ ७२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी ही मूर्खलक्षणें आहेत. ती ऐकून माणसे हुशार होतात. शहाणे लोक ती लक्ष देऊन नेहमी ऐकतात. (व त्यांचा त्याग करतात.)
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless atma is like this when it has the attention of the fool. But through shravan (listening to this `I am') wisdom is imbibed, for if one always listens carefully then, one's chitta (thinking aspect of the inner mind) is given understanding (if one throws out all the concepts from their mind then, this `I am' can be clearly heard).

owis.original: लक्षणें अपार असती । परी कांहीं येक येथामती । त्यागार्थ बोलिलें श्रोतीं । क्ष्मा केलें पाहिजे ॥ ७३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी ही मूर्खलक्षणें पुष्कळ आहेत. त्यांतील कांही माझ्या बुद्धीस सुचली ती लोकांनी त्यागावी म्हणून येथे सांगितली. त्याबद्दल लोकांनी क्षमा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: When that limitless paramatma listens then, that One within this `all' (that purush within His prakruti) still remains within the mind (ie. the universal mind). Nevertheless, if the listener listens to this `speech' within, then that true meaning of renunciation is understood. But understand clearly; that requires great forbearance and patience (let whatever is going to come, come and whatever has to go, go. No holding or rejection)

owis.original: उत्तम लक्षणें घ्यावीं । मूर्खलक्षणें त्यागावीं । पुढिले समासीं आघवीं । निरोपिलीं ॥ ७४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण उत्तम लक्षणे घ्यावी, (त्यांचा अंगीकार करावा) व मूर्ख लक्षणे त्यागावीत. पुढील समसांत उत्तम लक्षणें सांगितली आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: By this listening, that superior guna should be accepted and the attention of the foolish should be given up (ie. mixed gunas). Then afterwards there will be this silent discourse within the composition of words. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: श्रोतां व्हावें सावधान । आतां सांगतों उत्तम गुण । जेणें करितां बाणे खुण । सर्वज्ञपणाची ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यांनी लक्षपूर्वक ऐकावे. मी आता उत्तम गुण सांगतो आहे. जे अंगी बाणवल्याने प्रपंच व परमार्थ ह्या दोन्हीचे ज्ञान प्राप्त होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: If you are an ever alert listener then, now (when there is the `I am') you can recognize that it is the atma who is knowing this superior guna (ie. this pure sattwa guna of effortless knowing). Then on account of this `all'-knowingness of mula maya you can accept that nirgun understanding (if you remain in this pure sattwa guna then this will go off, of its own accord, and what then remains is that nirgun ie. beyond knowledge).

owis.original: वाट पुसिल्याविण जाऊं नये । फळ वोळखिल्याविण खाऊं नये । पडिली वस्तु घेऊं नये । येकायेकीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाट (माहित असल्याशिवाय) विचारल्याशिवाय प्रवासास जाऊं नये. फळ ओळखिल्याशिवाय खाऊं नये. वस्तु पडलेली दिसली तर एकदम उचलून घेऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as you have to ask the way when you are going somewhere that you have never been before, so too, without first recognizing this fruit of knowledge, how will it ever be consumed/absorbed? (How can there be vignyan/the relinquishing of knowledge, wi- thout first recognizing knowledge?) So even if that Reality has fallen down and become knowledge, still it should not accept to become a jiva.

owis.original: अति वाद करुं नये । पोटीं कपट धरुं नये । शोधिल्याविण करुं नये । कुळहीन कांता ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार वादावादी करुं नये. कपटीपणाने वागू नये. (बाहेरुन गोड परंतु पोटांत कपट असे वागूं नये.) कुलशीलाची नीट माहिती करुन घेतल्यावाचून मुलीशी लग्न करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Too much discussion should not be made and the false should not be held in your heart. You should search carefully and not take a wife from an inferior family (one should search out prakruti and take her as your wife and not accept body consciousness).

owis.original: विचारेंविण बोलों नये । विवंचनेविण चालों नये । मर्यादेविण हालों नये । कांहीं येक ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सारासार विचार केल्याशिवाय बोलू (न मागता सल्लासुद्धा) नये. कार्य सुरु करतांना सर्वांगीण बाजूंचा विचार केल्याशिवाय कार्य सुरु करु नये. नीतिअनीतिचा विचार केल्याशिवाय हालचाल करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One could not `speak' without that thoughtless Self (that thoughtless pure knowledge is the base of knowledge/`speech' and this is the base of the objective world) and therefore one should not proceed without such *investigation. But one cannot awaken that One within this `thing'/`all', without due restraint (first the `many' thoughts should be brought under control by vivek). *(Discrimination between sagun and nirgun)

owis.original: प्रीतीविण रुसों नये । चोरास वोळखी पुसों नये । रात्रीं पंथ क्रमूं नये । येकायेकीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रेम नसेल तेथे रुसणे नको. चोराला माहिती देऊं नये. अचानक रात्री प्रवास करु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma purush should not sulk without love (I want nothing, even if spurned by this world, still I will not move) and that purush should not wipe out the *known for this thief called mind, for It will become a jiva within the One pure brahman. You should not travel on this road to liberation in the night of ignorance (if you continue to take yourself to be a jiva then, how can you be liberated?). *(prakruti)

owis.original: जनीं आर्जव तोडूं नये । पापद्रव्य जोडूं नये । पुण्यमार्ग सोडूं नये । कदाकाळीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांशी सरळपणाने वागणे सोडूं नये. पापमार्गाने पैसा जोडूं नये. कधीही नीतिने वागणें सोडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Justice (ie. vivek) should not be broken by the mind and sinful wealth should not be amassed (objectification, "I am a body and this is such and such" etc.). The path of virtue (`I am He') should not be left at any time.

owis.original: निंदा द्वेष करुं नये । असत्संग धरुं नये । द्रव्यदारा हरुं नये । बळात्कारें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाचीही निंदा, द्वेष करुं नये. अयोग्य, वाईट लोकांशी संगत, मैत्री करु नये. दुसर्‍याची बायको किंवा पैसा बळात्कारानें लुबाडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush should not blame or become anxious nor should That keep the company of the false; and That should not forcibly seize wealth or woman (one should not desire this manifest world, let whatever naturally comes come and whatever goes, go. Do not try to hold on to these sensory objects).

owis.original: वक्तयास खोदूं नये । ऐक्यतेसी फोडूं नये । विद्याअभ्यास सोडूं नये कांहीं केल्यां ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वक्त्याला प्रश्र्ण विचारुन हैराण करुं नये. एकीने राहणार्‍या लोकांत फूट पाडू नये. कांही झाले तरी विद्या-अभ्यास सोडू नये. (ज्ञान मिळवणे सोडूं नये).
owis.englishMeaning: That purush should not contradict the *`speaker' (the speaker is the purush and He makes the `speech'; but the mind does not agree with His `speech') and therefore break this unity. That should not give up the practice of knowing this created `all'. *(The `speaker' is yourself and the listener is also yourself, for there is only yourself in the world)

owis.original: तोंडाळासीं भांडों नये । वाचाळासीं तंडों नये । संतसंग खंडूं नये । अंतर्यामीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तोंडाळ लोकांशी भांडण करु नये. वाचाळ माणसाशी वादंग करुं नये. अंतर्यामी (मनांवर) झालेले चांगले संस्कार सोडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush should not quarrel with the foul-mouthed and should not wrangle with the talkative (ie. the chattering mind). That should not break the *company of the Truth/Saint within. *(satsang)

owis.original: अति क्रोध करुं नये । जिवलगांस खेदूं नये । मनीं वीट मानूं नये । सिकवणेचा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार रागावू नये. जिवलग नातेवाईक, मित्र यांना दुखवूं नये. चांगले शिकून घेण्याचा कंटाळा करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush should not get very angry with nor trouble That which is most dear (atma/Self). That should not feel weariness in the mind nor have the vanity of teaching.

owis.original: क्षणक्षणा रुसों नये । लटिका पुरुषार्थ बोलों नये । केल्याविण सांगों नये । आपला पराक्रमु ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सारखे सारखे रुसूं नये. खोटेपणा करुन न केलेली गोष्ट सांगू नये. काहीहीं न करता (आपला पराक्रम) आपण केले असे सांगू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Not for one moment should that Self sulk or `speak' of the false meaning of life. That should not make the understanding, I do not exist, without first accomplishing this great feat of `I am this all'.

owis.original: बोलिला बोल विसरों नये । प्रसंगीं सामर्थ्य चुकों न.ये । केल्याविण निखंदूं नये । पुढिलांसी कदा ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण दिलेला शब्द विसरुं नये. योग्य प्रसंगी आपल्या शक्तिचा वापर करण्यास चुकू नये. कार्य करुन दाखविल्याशिवाय दुसर्‍याला कधीही बोल लावूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Speak the `speech' that cannot be forgotten (for it does not have to be remembered; it is natural) and in that harmonious connection of this `all', this power should not be lost; that purush should not criticize that which is previous and less objective.

owis.original: आळसें सुख मानूं नये । चाहाडी मनास आणूं नये । शोधिल्याविण करुं नये । कार्य कांहीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आळसांत पडून राहण्यांत सुख मानू नये. कोणाची चुगली-चहाडी करु नये. कोणतेही कार्य सर्वांगीण विचार केल्याशिवाय करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush should not feel pleasure in laziness nor should That invent and tell tall tales of this world; for unless you carefully search and purify your mind, you cannot make this action of the `all'.

owis.original: सुखा आंग देऊं नये । प्रेत्न पुरुषें सांडूं नये । कष्ट करितां त्रासो नये । निरंतर ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाला अति सुखाची सवय लावूं नये. निरंतर प्रयत्न करण्याचे सोडूं नये. कधीही (आणि कितीही) कष्ट करावे लागले तरी त्रासून जाऊ नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush should not be concerned for pleasure and He should not give up the effort of that purush (ie. He negates everything). You should not made wearisome efforts and bring toil and trouble to that One who is without any inner space (parabrahman).

owis.original: सभेमध्यें लाजों नये । बाष्कळपणें बोलों नये । पैज होड घालूं नये । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सभेमधे लाजूं नये. (धिटाईने वागावे.) परंतु वायफळ बडबड करु नये. कधीही (कसलीही) पैज लावूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush should not feel abashed in this meeting place of the `all' and that should not speak frivolously (He should stay hidden within this `all' and He should never say, "I am so and so etc."). That atma should not make any agreement with this created `all' and remain aloft always.

owis.original: बहुत चिंता करुं नये । निसुगपणें राहों नये । परस्त्रीतें पाहों नये । पापबुद्धी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार चिंता करुं नये. आळशीपणांत दिवस घालवू नये. वाईट दृष्टीने दुसर्‍याच्या बायकोकडे पाहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The `all' should not think or worry nor should it remain a miserable body. That Self should not look at another woman with lust in its mind. (maharaj- you see a woman and the Master sees brahman)

owis.original: कोणाचा उपकार घेऊं नये । घेतला तरी राखों नये । परपीडा करुं नये । विस्वासघात ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाच्या उपकाराचे ओझें बाळगूं नये. कोणी उपकार केल्यास तो फेडल्याशिवाय राहूं नये. दुसर्‍याचा विश्र्वासघात करुन त्याला पीडा देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not be under any obligation to this `all'. But if taken, you should not keep it in the mind (continually let go this moving `all', like the flowing of a river). You should not take the troubles of another (become a body) and therefore destroy your faith.

owis.original: शोच्येंविण असों नये । मळिण वस्त्र नेसों नये । जाणारास पुसों नये । कोठे जातोस म्हणौनी ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वच्छतेशिवाय राहूं नये. मलीन वस्त्र नेसूं नये. कोणी बाहेर जावयास निघाल्यावर त्याला कोठे जातोस म्हणून विचारु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not remain without being purified of all defilement; you should not wear the filthy covering of this body and you should not wipe out that Knower, by asking, "Where are you going?" (Myself is everywhere; do not see separateness; why to take the touch of this world?)

owis.original: व्यापकपण सांडूं नये । पराधेन होऊं नये । आपलें वोझें घालूं नये । कोणीयेकासी ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला उदारपणा सोडू नये. कोणाच्या आधीन होऊं नये. परावलंबी किंवा दुसर्‍यावर आपले ओझें घालून राहू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not wipe out your own pervasiveness. You should not be dependent and you should not place your burden ("I am a body") upon that One who is within everyone.

owis.original: पत्रेंविण पर्वत करुं नये । हीनाचें रुण घेऊं नये । गोहीविण जाऊं नये । राजद्वारा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कागदपत्र केल्याशिवाय देण्या-घेण्याचे व्यवहार करु नये. हीन माणसाकडून कर्ज घेऊं नये. साक्षी-पुराव्याशिवाय कोर्टाची पायरी चढूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Without being the worthy recipient of knowledge, you should not make any transaction (let whatever comes, come). You should not be in the debt of this inferior condition (`I do not need this body, it however needs me') and you should not go to the King's palace without a Witness (the King is the atma and His palace is this `all').

owis.original: लटिकी जाजू घेऊं नये । सभेस लटिके करुं नये । आदर नस्तां बोलों नये । स्वभाविक ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खोटी हुज्जत घालूं नये. सर्व सभेला खोटे ठरवूं नये. ज्या ठिकाणी आपल्याला आदर-मान नाही तेथे बोलूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not give false testimony (ie. "I am so and so")1 and you should not falsify or deny this meeting place (of `Myself is everywhere'). That Self should not `speak' without due care and attention to His own true nature.

owis.original: आदखणेपण करुं नये । अन्यायेंविण गांजूं नये । अवनीतीनें वर्तों नये । आंगबळें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: महत्वाच्या गोष्टींकडे दुर्लक्ष करु नये. अन्यायाखेरीज कोणाला दुखवूं नये. अंगी फार शक्ती आहे म्हणुन दांडगेपणे वागूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not be envious of *riches and you should not annoy/tease That which is without fault. That atma should not live with injustice ("I am a body") but it should hold the conviction, `I am'. *(maharaj- if a poor man sees a rich man being driven by in a big car then, he should feel, myself is there)

owis.original: बहुत अन्न खाऊं नये । बहुत निद्रा करुं नये । बहुत दिवस राहों नये । पिसुणाचेथें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार जेवण करुं नये. फार झोप काढूं नये. वाईट माणसाकडे फार दिवस राहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' should not consume this *divine `food' and this `all' should not fall asleep (this `all' means to be awake; to have awoken from this dream of samsar). This `all' should not stay for even a day in the house of the vile (this body is the house you have been residing in). *(This food is `I am'/life and it is divine; for without this, one could not exist for a even a moment. This should not be consumed ie. forgotten, when you eat the gross food and should always be kept in your mind. Then you are not `shit-factories' and every action becomes divine)

owis.original: आपल्याची गोही देऊं नये । आपली कीर्ती वर्णूं नये । आपलें आपण हासों नये । गोष्टी सांगोनी ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला म्हणून त्याच्या बाजूने साक्ष देऊं नये. आपल्या मोठेपणाचे आपणच प्रदर्शन करुं नये. गोष्टी सांगत आपले आपण हसूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma should not give its own testimony (if you say, "I have understood myself" then, you have not been to that place; maharaj- how to know yourself. Can you kiss yourself?). That should not recount its own pervasiveness (for then you become body consciousness). That should not ridicule its Self by thinking, "I am a body" and That should bring the understanding, I do not exist, to this thought of creation (`I am He'). 1siddharameshwar maharaj- Standing in the witness box in court every witness says, "I swear before God to tell the truth, the whole truth and tell no lies." Taking such an oath, he swears that "My name is Dhondopant, my father's name is Dagadopant, my age is this, my caste is that, my address is such and such." However, even after taking the oath, he still is entirely untruthful. But what testimony can be given other than this? In court there was no mention of any punishment for these lies of the witness. But he will surely receive the punishment of the 8.4 million births. He who has no name, has no father, who is birthless, whose age cannot be told, who has no caste, creed nor occupation and because of His omni-presence cannot say, "I am from such and such place;" that this Supreme purusha, devoid of any distinction of space, time and object, should give such false witness. Well! Such is the great power of maya.

owis.original: धूम्रपान घेऊं नये । उन्मत्त द्रव्य सेऊं नये । बहुचकासीं करुं नये । मैत्री कदा ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: धूम्रपान करुं नये. मादक पेय पिवूं नये. बोंबड्या माणसाशी मैत्री कधीच करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma should not accept the practice of smoking and That should not taste *in- toxicating substances (sensory experiences) and That one should not take the support of the `many' objects and never make friendship with them. *(`The body does all these things, I do not do!')

owis.original: कामेंविण राहों नये । नीच उत्तर साहों नये । आसुदें अन्न सेऊं नये । वडिलांचेंहि ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: काम, उद्योग याशिवाय राहूं नये. कोणी अपमानास्पद (नीच) बोलला तर सहन करु नये. वडिलांचेही आयते अन्न खाऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not stay without this action of knowledge and you should not tolerate degrading remarks (from your mind and you should give such a reply that the mind goes off, `I am He'). You should not taste the impure food (of the `many' sensory experiences), even though it has come from that atma (in truth, everything is that pure atma but it is not enough to know this intellectually only. That atma tastes of the divine `food' of `I am'; He is `all'- knowing and this must be your experience).

owis.original: तोंडीं सीवी असों नये । दुसर्‍यास देखोन हांसों नये । उणें अंगीं संचारों नये । कुळवंताचे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तोडांत शिवी (घाणेरडी भाषा) असूं नये. दुसर्‍यास हासूं नये. कुळवान, शीलवान माणसाचे अंगी हीनपणा लावूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That should not use abusive speech; that purush should realize this `all' (prakruti) and not laugh at it; That should not enter within the inferior gross body that is within this `all' body and That should always stay as the possessor of this `all'.

owis.original: देखिली वस्तु चोरुं नये । बहुत कृपण होऊं नये । जिवलगांसीं करुं नये । कळह कदा ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाहिलेली वस्तु (आवडली म्हणून) चोरु नये. फार कंजूषपणा करुं नये. आपल्या माणसांशी भांडण करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: That Supreme Self should be realized and not stolen away by your mind and this `all' should not become a miser ("I need this thing and that thing" and store away so many things); the jiva should never argue with that One who is the dearest of all.

owis.original: येकाचा घात करुं नये । लटिकी गोही देऊं नये । अप्रमाण वर्तों नये । कदाकाळीं ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाचाही घात करुन त्याचे वाईट करुं नये. खोटी साक्ष देऊं नये. कधीही आपली वर्तणुक शास्त्राच्या विरुद्ध असूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not destroy that One (nirgun) nor should one give false witness ("Something happened" say, "Nothing has happened"); one should never exist and act without the authority of that atma and with the authority of body consciousness.

owis.original: चाहाडी चोरी धरुं नये । परद्वार करुं नये । मागें उणें बोलों नये । कोणीयेकाचें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाची चहाडी, चोरी करुं नये. परस्त्रीशीं गैर (अनीतीने) वागू नये. कोणाच्याही मागे त्याच्याबद्दल वाईट बोलूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not keep the stolen fabricated tales of this world; you should not enter the door of another (ie. this gross world); that Self should not speak of the previous faults of that One who is within everyone (ie. forget the past and speak `I am').

owis.original: समईं यावा चुकों नये । सत्वगुण सांडूं नये । वैरियास दंडूं नये । शरण आलियां ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसर्‍यास मदतीची संधी सोडू नये. सत्वगुणाने वागणे कदापी सोडू नये. शरण आलेल्यास (चुकीची कबुली देणारास) शिक्षा करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not forget/give up your power of `now' (this is the time of the `all' or the power of prakruti. It is the beginning of time and space; the purush is beyond this time and space); you should not let the sattwa guna slip away and you should not punish the enemy (ego/mind) who comes to you for refuge.

owis.original: अल्पधनें माजों नये । हरिभक्तीस लाजों नये । मर्यादेविण चालों नये । पवित्र जनीं ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कमी-अधिक पैसा मिळाला तरी त्याचे माजाने वागू नये. भगवंताची भक्ती करतांना लाजू नये. संत-महंत असलेल्या पवित्र ठिकाणी अमर्यादेने वर्तन करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not get arrogant with a little *wealth (all the wealth of this world is nothing, placed against the wealth of liberation and freedom from birth and death); you should not be ashamed to be devoted to hari and the purified should not behave without constraint in the mind. *(Christ- What does a man profit if he gains the whole world but loses his soul?)

owis.original: मूर्खासीं समंध पडों नये । अंधारीं हात घालूं नये । दुश्र्चितपणें विसरों नये । वस्तु आपुली ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूर्खांशी संबंध ठेवू नये. अंधार असलेल्या ठिकाणी हात घालूं नये. आपली वस्तु विसरण्याचा निष्काळजीपणा करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should have no dealings with the foolish; you should not enter into the darkness of ignorance; you should not forget your own Self through inattentiveness.

owis.original: स्नानसंध्या सांडूं नये । कुळाचार खंडूं नये । अनाचार मांडूं नये । चुकुरपणें ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्नान-संध्याआदि आपले आन्हिक सोडूं नये. कुलाचार सोडू नये. चुकारपणाने अनाचाराने वागूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not give up your sacred bath and prayers of the brahmin, (you are a true brahmin if you purify your mind in the waters of knowledge and remember your swarup); you should perform the conduct of your lineage (ie. you belong to your guru); you should not get placed in the unrestrained mind by forgetting your swarup.

owis.original: हरिकथा सांडूं नये । निरुपण तोडूं नये । परमार्थास मोडूं नये । प्रपंचबळें ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हरिकथा, भजन, किर्तन आदि सोडूं नये.  प्रवचन निरुपण आदि सोडूं नये. प्रपंचाच्यामागे लागून परमार्थाची वाट सोडू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not give up this `story' of *hari and this sagun discourse should not be broken; you should not break paramarth (Supreme Accomplishment) with the force of prapanch (worldly accomplishments). *(hari is vishnu, means to know)

owis.original: देवाचा नवस बुडऊं नये । आपला धर्म उडऊं नये । भलतें भरीं भरों नये । विचारेंविण ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाचा नवस फेडण्यास चुकू नये. आपला धर्म विरोधी वागून सोडू नये.  विचाराने न वागता भलते काम अंगावर घेऊ नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not destroy this pact with God nor should you dismiss your dharma (inhe- rent nature ie. to be and to know); you should not fondly run after all that which is irrelevant and void of that pure understanding, I do not exist.

owis.original: निष्ठुरपण धरुं नये । जीवहत्या करुं नये । पाउस देखोन जाऊं नये । अथवा अवकाळीं ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निष्ठूरपणे वागू नये. जीवाची हिंसा करु नये. पाऊस असेल तर किंवा योग्य काळ नसेल तर प्रवासास जाऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not hold on obstinately to being a jiva and thus become the killer of the jiva (our own concepts are the cause of our destruction); you should not believe in a time of plenty or a time of adversity (ie. understand, `nothing has happened'). (maharaj- say I have created everything...if someone dies, it is may wish, if a child is born, it is my wish).

owis.original: सभा देखोन गळों नये । समईं उत्तर टळों नये । धिःकारिता चळों नये । धारिष्ट आपुलें ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सभेमध्ये घाबरु नये. वेळप्रसंगी योग्य उत्तर देण्यास चुकू नये. कोणी धिःकारिले तरी आपले धैर्य गमावूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This meeting place should be understood and never left; in this `now', you should not dismiss this reply (maharaj- reply to the mind so nicely that the mind goes off; `I am He'); you should not yield to scorn and always have courage and patience.

owis.original: गुरुविरहित असों नये । नीच यातीचा गुरु करुं नये । जिणें शाश्र्वत मानूं नये । वैभवेंसीं ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गुरुशिवाय राहू नये. हलक्या जातीचा गुरु करु नये. वैभवाचे जीणे कायमचे समजू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not be without the guru; you should never have a guru from a lowly caste (one should have a brahmin ie. a Knower of brahman, and not a knower of the body); and you should not believe that living with this grandeur of the `all' is that eternal Self.

owis.original: सत्यमार्ग सांडूं नये । असत्य पंथे जाऊं नये । कदा अभिमान घेऊं नये । असत्याचा ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सत्याचा मार्ग सोडू नये. असत्याचे मार्गे जाऊ नये. खोट्या वागणुकीचा अभिमान बाळगू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: You should not leave the way of the Truth and travel on the road of untruth and you should never accept the ego of the untrue.

owis.original: अपकीर्ति ते सांडावी । सदकीर्ति वाढवावी । विवेकें दृढ धरावी । वाट सत्याची ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अपकीर्तिच्या मार्गे जाऊ नये. सद्कीर्तिच्या मार्गे जावे. योग्य विचाराने सत्याचा मार्ग धरुन ठेवावा. (सत्कर्मे करुन सद्कीर्ति मिळवून देणारी सत्याची वाट घट्ट धरुन मार्ग चालावा.)
owis.englishMeaning: That Reality should let slip this insignificant pervasiveness of the gross body and should increase its pervasiveness; by careful vivek you should hold fast to the path of Truth.

owis.original: नेघतां हे उत्तम गुण । तें मनुष्य अवलक्षण । ऐक तयांचे लक्षण । पुढिले समासीं ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो कोणी हे उत्तमगुण अंगीकारत नाही, तो अवलक्षणीच होय. त्याची लक्षणे पुढील समासी ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: If you do not accept that superior guna (pure sattwa guna; `I am everything, every- where') then, that Reality becomes an inattentive, unfortunate man. Therefore ahead `listen' carefully and this attention will become that thoughtless Reality that is within this composition of words. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Kuvidya Lakshan (The Characteristics of Bad Knowledge)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ऐका कुविद्येचीं लक्षणें । अति हीने कुलक्षणें । त्यागार्थ बोलिलीं ते श्रवणें । त्याग घडे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां कुविद्येची लक्षणें ऐका. ती अति हीन आहेत. मनुष्याने त्यांचा त्याग करावा. ती ऐकली म्हणजे त्यांचा त्याग घडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Listen (to this `speech'/knowledge)! Otherwise your attention will be given to wrong knowledge and this brings the most base and inferior forms (body and gross objects). The fruit of renunciation is this `speech' and by listening carefully to this `speech' the gross will be renounced.

owis.original: ऐका कुविद्येचा प्राणी । जन्मा येऊन केली हानी । सांगिजेल येहीं लक्षणीं । वोळखावा ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कुविद्येचा माणुस कसा असतो ते सांगतो. जन्माला येऊन तो स्वतःचे नुकसान करुन घेतो. येथे सांगितलेल्या लक्षणांवरुन तो ओळखू येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Listen (to this knowledge and forget every other thing), for wrong knowledge brings birth and destruction in the prana. When that attention-less swarup within this listening is recognized then, there will be that thoughtless understanding.

owis.original: कुविद्येचा प्राणी असे । तो कठिण निरुपणें त्रासे । अवगुणाची समृद्धि असे । म्हणौनियां ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कुविद्येचा माणुस अति अवगुणी असतो. ते जावेत म्हणून कोणी त्यास कांहीं सांगू लागला तर त्यामुळे कुविद्येचा माणुस त्रासतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But when that atma takes birth in the prana and acquires wrong knowledge ("I am a body and I breath"; renunciation is, `I am not the body; the body breathes but I am not the breath'), then it is troubled by the `many' harsh and gross discourses and there is an overflowing of these inferior gunas (the mix of sattwa, rajas and tamas; ie. knowledge/ignorance and imagination).

owis.original: काम क्रोध मद मत्सर । लोभ दंभ तिरस्कार । गर्व ताठा अहंकार । द्वेष विषाद विकल्पी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कामी, क्रोधी, मदाने, मत्सराने भरलेला, लोभी, दंभी, तिरस्कार करणारा, गर्विष्ठ, ताठा, अहंकारी, द्वेषी, विषादी, विकल्पी, आशा, ममता, तृष्णा, कल्पनांत रमणारा, चिंताग्रस्त, अहंता, कामना, भावना, असूया, अविद्या, ईषणा, वासना, अतृप्ती, लोलंगता, इच्छा, वासना, चिकित्सा, निंदा, अनीति, गुंडगिरी, सदा मस्तवाल, अवज्ञा, विपत्ति, आपदा, दुर्वृत्ती, दुर्वासना, स्पर्धा, खटपट, तर्‍हेवाईकपणा, अस्वस्थता, घाईंत काम उकणारा, अस्वस्थ, वटवट्या, तक्रारखोर, या लक्षणांनी कुविद्या प्रगट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: These bring desire/kam, anger/krodh, pride, envy, greed, hypocrisy, malice, arrogance, obstinacy, ego, anxiety, depression and doubtfulness.

owis.original: आशा ममता तृष्णा कल्पना । चिंता अहंता कामना भावना । असूया अविद्या ईषणा वासना । अतृप्ती लोलंगता ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कामी, क्रोधी, मदाने, मत्सराने भरलेला, लोभी, दंभी, तिरस्कार करणारा, गर्विष्ठ, ताठा, अहंकारी, द्वेषी, विषादी, विकल्पी, आशा, ममता, तृष्णा, कल्पनांत रमणारा, चिंताग्रस्त, अहंता, कामना, भावना, असूया, अविद्या, ईषणा, वासना, अतृप्ती, लोलंगता, इच्छा, वासना, चिकित्सा, निंदा, अनीति, गुंडगिरी, सदा मस्तवाल, अवज्ञा, विपत्ति, आपदा, दुर्वृत्ती, दुर्वासना, स्पर्धा, खटपट, तर्‍हेवाईकपणा, अस्वस्थता, घाईंत काम उकणारा, अस्वस्थ, वटवट्या, तक्रारखोर, या लक्षणांनी कुविद्या प्रगट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: These bring hope, possessiveness, hankering, imagination, worry, the sense of ego, *va- sana, emotion, envy, ignorance, aspiration, desire for physical pleasure, discontent, im- patience. *(Deep rooted desire to be body; one imagines I cannot live and experience without a body)

owis.original: इछ्या वांछ्या चिकिछ्या निंदा । आनित्य ग्रामणी मस्ती सदा । जाणीव अवज्ञा विपत्ती आपदा । दुर्वृत्ती दुर्वासना ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कामी, क्रोधी, मदाने, मत्सराने भरलेला, लोभी, दंभी, तिरस्कार करणारा, गर्विष्ठ, ताठा, अहंकारी, द्वेषी, विषादी, विकल्पी, आशा, ममता, तृष्णा, कल्पनांत रमणारा, चिंताग्रस्त, अहंता, कामना, भावना, असूया, अविद्या, ईषणा, वासना, अतृप्ती, लोलंगता, इच्छा, वासना, चिकित्सा, निंदा, अनीति, गुंडगिरी, सदा मस्तवाल, अवज्ञा, विपत्ति, आपदा, दुर्वृत्ती, दुर्वासना, स्पर्धा, खटपट, तर्‍हेवाईकपणा, अस्वस्थता, घाईंत काम उकणारा, अस्वस्थ, वटवट्या, तक्रारखोर, या लक्षणांनी कुविद्या प्रगट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there are cravings, wishes, criticism, slander, bad conduct, violence, pride of knowledge, disobedience, difficulties, calamities, and the vritti that is far from the atma, and the vasana that is far from the atma. (The pure vritti wants just to know; the pure vasana wants just to be )

owis.original: स्पर्धा खटपट आणी चटपट । तर्‍हे झटपट आणी वटवट । सदा खटखट आणी लटपट । परम वेथा कुविद्या ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कामी, क्रोधी, मदाने, मत्सराने भरलेला, लोभी, दंभी, तिरस्कार करणारा, गर्विष्ठ, ताठा, अहंकारी, द्वेषी, विषादी, विकल्पी, आशा, ममता, तृष्णा, कल्पनांत रमणारा, चिंताग्रस्त, अहंता, कामना, भावना, असूया, अविद्या, ईषणा, वासना, अतृप्ती, लोलंगता, इच्छा, वासना, चिकित्सा, निंदा, अनीति, गुंडगिरी, सदा मस्तवाल, अवज्ञा, विपत्ति, आपदा, दुर्वृत्ती, दुर्वासना, स्पर्धा, खटपट, तर्‍हेवाईकपणा, अस्वस्थता, घाईंत काम उकणारा, अस्वस्थ, वटवट्या, तक्रारखोर, या लक्षणांनी कुविद्या प्रगट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is envious quarrelling and fretting and grieving; all kinds of toil and moil and chatter; continuous harassment and restless activity. This inferior knowledge is acutely painful.

owis.original: कुरुप आणि कुलक्षण । अशक्त आणी दुर्जन । दरिद्री आणि कृपण । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कुविद्येचा मनुष्य कुरुप, हीन लक्षणी, अशक्त, दुर्जन, दरिद्री आणि अतिशय कंजुष असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is this defective form (a body and not formless) and this defective attention (mixed knowing/ignorance and not pure knowing); then one is weak (ashakti ie. not having the shakti, `I am'), wicked, penniless and miserly to the worst degree. (All qualities of the gross body and its ego and not the formless, egoless Self)

owis.original: आळसी आणि खादाड । दुर्बळ आणी लाताड । तुटक आणी लाबाड । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो अत्यंत आळशी, खादाड, दुर्बळ, लाथा मारणारा, अति लबाड व दुसर्‍यास तोडून बोणारा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then one is lazy and gluttonous; weak and yet violent; scornful and cunning to the worst degree.

owis.original: मूर्ख आणी तपीळ । वेडें आणी वाचाळ । लटिकें आणी तोंडाळ । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो मूर्ख, तापट, वेडपट, वाचाळ, खोटारडा व फार तोंडाळ असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then one is foolish and hot tempered, mad after the sense objects and talkative; then one speaks falsely and is quarrelsome to the worst degree.

owis.original: नेणे आणी नायके । न ये आणी न सीके । न करी आणी न देखे । अभ्यासदृष्टी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कुविद्या ज्याच्या आंगी त्याला स्वतःला काही कळत नसूनही दुसर्‍याने सांगितलेलेही तो ऐकत नाही. काही येत नाही व दुसर्‍याकडून काही शिकतही नाही. स्वतः करत नाही व अभ्यासूपणे बघतही नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is ignorance and ownership of it ("I am so and so and I do everything") then, that thoughtless understanding is not and it cannot be learned. Then even this vision of knowledge, acquired through study, cannot be made.

owis.original: अज्ञान आणी अविश्र्वासी । छळवादी आणी दोषी । अभक्त आणी भक्तांसी । देखों सकेना ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो अज्ञानी व अविश्र्वासु असतो. छळवादी व ज्यांतत्यांत दोष काढणारा असतो. स्वतः भक्ती न करणारा व भक्ती करणाराचा द्वेष करणारा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is the ignorance and faithlessness; then there is harassment and sin; such a non-devotee cannot possibly understand a devotee.

owis.original: पापी आणी निंदक । कष्टी आणी घातक । दुःखी आणी हिंसक । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो पापी असून सतत कोणाची तरी निंदा करत असतो. क्लेश भोगत असून  दुसर्‍यांचा घात करणारा, दुःखी व अति निर्दयी असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this wrong knowledge one is a condemning, abusive *sinner; always worrying and dangerous; unhappy and violent to the worst degree. *(maharaj- there is only one sin and that is taking yourself to be a body)

owis.original: हीन आणी कृत्रिमी । रोगी आणी कुकर्मी । आचंगुल आणी अधर्मी । वासना रमे ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो हीन व ढोंगी, रोगी व वाईट कामे करणारा, कृपण व अधार्मिक वासनेचा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is the base, fake and artificial; then there are the diseased (ie. body consci- ousness) who make base and lowly actions; then one is narrow-minded and opposed to one's dharma and this vasana, to simply be, delights in wanton frivolous play.

owis.original: हीन देह आणी ताठा । अप्रमाण आणी फांटा । बाष्कळ आणी करंटा । विवेक सांगे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हीन देहाचा व अभिमानी, वाह्यात, फाटे फोडणारा, वायफळ बडबड करणारा, दुर्दैवी व लोकांना उपदेश करणारा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this inferior gross body and mind then, there is arrogance; then the mind has no authority and is a sprout of endless chatter; then that thoughtless understanding is the vivek of a frivolous beggar.

owis.original: लंडी आणी उन्मत्त । निकामी आणी डुल्लत । भ्याड आणी बोलत । पराक्रमु ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो भित्रा व उद्धट; बिनकामाचा व पोकळ बडेजाव मिरविणारा, भित्रा व आपल्या पराक्रमाच्या (खोट्या) गोष्टी सांगणारा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is a deceitful coward, drunk with arrogance; useless and yet walking with a proud gait; he is fearful and has no courage to stay in this `speech'.

owis.original: कनिष्ठ आणी गर्विष्ठ । नुपरतें आणी नष्ट । द्वेषी आणी भ्रष्ट । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो कमी योग्यतेचा व गर्विष्ट; व्यसनी व विषयासक्त, लोकांचा द्वेष करणारा व अतिशय भ्रष्ट असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is inferior and proud; licentious and destructive; he is malicious and bewildered and confused, to the worst degree.

owis.original: अभिमानी आणी निसंगळ । वोडगस्त आणी खळ । दंभिक आणी अनर्गळ । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अभिमानी व योग्य बंधन झुगारणारा, ओढग्रस्त परिस्थितीचा व दुष्ट, ढोंगी व अति उच्छृंखल असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is full of pride and shameless with it; he is distressed and wicked; a hypocrite and willful to the worst degree.

owis.original: वोखटें आणी विकारी । खोटें आणी अनोपकारी । अवलक्षण आणी धिःकारी । प्राणीमात्रासी ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाईट व विकाराधीन, खोटारडा व अनोपकारी, अवलक्षणी व दुसर्‍यांचा तिरस्कार करणारा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is vile and full of agitation; full of lies and unhelpful; he has bad habits and is argumentative towards this `all'.

owis.original: अल्पमती आणी वादक । दीनरुप आणी भेदक । सूक्ष्म आणी त्रासक । कुशब्देंकरुनि ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कमी बुद्धीचा असुनही वाद घालणारा, भिकार्‍यासारखा असुनही दुसर्‍या टोचून बोलणारा, बारीकसारीक गोष्टींत दुसर्‍यास वाईट शब्दांनी बोलणारा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is feeble in understanding and yet opinionated; he is distressed and creates so many divisions; that brahman and the greatest of suffering are on account of these base words (within the `many' words there is the worst and the best; they damn us to be a body and they save us by right thinking and understanding).

owis.original: कठिणवचनी कर्कशवचनी । कापट्यवचनी संदेहवचनी । दुःखवचनी तीव्रवचनी । क्रूर निष्ठुर दुरात्मा ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कर्कश्य आवाजांत कठिण शब्दांनी दुसर्‍यास बोलणारा, कपटाने व संशयाने बोलणारा, दुःखदायक व बोचर्‍या शब्दांनी बोलणारा, क्रुर व निष्ठुर असा कुलक्षणी असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this `speech' of `I am', there are the harsh and cutting words; within this `speech' there is deceit and body consciousness; within this `speech' there is the sorrow created by stinging, cruel and violent words that are far from the atma.

owis.original: न्यूनवचनी पैशून्यवचनी । अशुभवचनी आनित्यवचनी । द्वेषवचनी अनृत्यवचनी । बाष्कळवचनी धिःकारु ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कमतरता शोधून त्याबद्दल बोलणारा, (किंवा दुसर्‍याची चूक शोधुन त्यास बोलणारा); घातकाने बोलणारा, अशुभ बोलणारा, वायफळ बोलणारा, द्वेषाने बोलणारा, खोटे बोलणारा, सतत धिःकाराने बोलणारा असा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this `speech' there is the defective and within this `speech' there is the de- structive and spiteful; within this `speech' there is the transitory; within this `speech' there is the anxious and debased and within this `speech' there is the frivolous and harsh.

owis.original: कपटी कुटिळ गाट्याळ । कुर्टें कुचर नट्याळ । कोपी कुधन टवाळ । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो कपटी, वाईट बुद्धीचा, आतल्या गाठीचा, क्षुद्र बुद्धिचा, कामचुकार, नाठाळ, रागीट, पापी मार्गाने द्रव्य मिळविणारा आणि अतिशय टवाळखोर असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is deceitful and slanderous and self-willed; morose, dishonest, vengeful and trouble- some; in this hut called the body there is the suspicious and idle, to the worst degree.

owis.original: तपीळ तामस अविचार । पापी अनर्थी अपस्मार । भूत समंधी संचार । आंगीं वसे ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो कुलक्षणी तापट, तामसी, अविचारी, पापी, अनर्थ करणारा, अपस्मारी व अंगांत भूत, समंध यांचा संचार असलेला असा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is bad tempered and affected by the tamo guna and therefore his thinking is impro- per; he is vicious and a great calamity; he is possessed by the `ghost' of the elements (they create an objective world and this gross body) and yet still, he is moving and dwelling within this `all' body (taking oneself to be a body yet watched over by this ever-present and attentive `all').

owis.original: आत्महत्यारा स्त्रीहत्यारा । गोहत्यारा ब्रह्महत्यारा । मातृहत्यारा पितृहत्यारा । माहापापी पतित ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो आत्मघातकी, स्त्रीघातकी, गायीला मारणारा, ब्राह्मणास मारणारा, आई-वडिलांचा घात करणारा, असा महापापी, पतित असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is a killer of the atma; a killer of the woman (prakruti/creation); he is a killer of the cow/that which gives anything you wish for and a killer of the brahmin (the one who knows brahman); he is a killer of his mother and his father (mula maya or prakriti and her purush); he has tumbled down into this body and become the great sinner.

owis.original: उणें कुपात्र कुतर्की । मित्रद्रोही विस्वासघातकी । कृतघ्न तल्पकी नारकी । अतित्याई जल्पक ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो सर्व बाबतींत कनिष्ठ, अयोग्य, वाईट तर्क करणारा, मित्रा द्रोह करणारा, विश्वासघातकी, कोणी केलेले उपकार न जाणणारा, परस्त्रीशी रत होणारा, नरकांत जाण्यास योग्य असलेला, आततयी व बडबड्या असा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to these faults he is an unworthy recipient of knowledge, for he is devoid of any proper logic; he destroys faith and is a traitor to his dearest friend (the atma); he is ungrateful, addicted to the sense objects, lives in hell and still he boasts of these things.

owis.original: किंत भांडण झगडा कळ्हो । अधर्म अनराहाटी शोक संग्रहो । चाहाड वेसनी विग्रहो । निग्रहकर्ता ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो संशयी, भांडखोर, झगडा करणारा, कलह घालणारा, अधर्मी, सदोदीत शोक करणारा, राहाटीप्रमाणे न राहणारा, चहाडखोर, व्यसनी, भेदाभेद करणारा व मोठा हट्टी असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: His life is rampant with doubts, arguments, tussles, quarrels and disputes; his actions are a-dharma and his behaviour is immoral and the source of great sorrow; he slanders others behind their backs; he is domineering and has so many bad and vicious habits.

owis.original: द्वाड आपेसी वोंगळ । चाळक चुंबक लच्याळ । स्वार्थी अभिळासी वोडाळ । आद्दत्त झोड आदखणा ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो खोडकर, अपयशी, घाणेरडा, चाळवणारा, कवडीचुंबक, लोचट, स्वार्थी, हावरा, स्वैर वर्तनी, अपरोपकारी (घट्ट मुठीचा), शिरजोर, दुसर्‍याचे चांगले झालेले बघु न शकणारा असा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is wicked and dishonourable; flirtatious and hurtful and a teller of tales ("I am so and so and this is such and such"); he is self-centered with a greedy, rambling mind; he is easily angered and malicious too.

owis.original: शठ शुंभ कातरु । लंड तर्मुंड सिंतरु । बंड पाषांड तश्करु । अपहारकर्ता ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कुलक्षणी लबाड, मठ्ठ, प्रसंगी काचकुच करणारा, बेपर्वाईने वागणारा, लुडबुड करणारा, लफंगा, उद्धट, गाजावाजा करणारा, चोर व दुसर्‍याच्या वस्तु पळविणारा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: A stupid coward, obstructive, deceitful, disloyal, untrustworthy and sacrilegious; these are his vices. He likes too plunder and destroys.

owis.original: धीट सैराट मोकाट । चाट चावट वाजट । थोट उद्धट लंपट । बटवाल कुबुद्धी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो कुलक्षणी धीट, स्वैराचारी, मोकाट, चटोर, चावट, गाजावाजा करणारा, थोतांड रचणारा, उद्धट, लंपट, भ्रष्ट व वाईट बुद्धीचा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is bold and unabashed, stupid and unrestrained in his behaviour; he babbles and cheats and he is an arrogant rogue with devious thinking and infatuated by women.

owis.original: मारेकरी वरपेकरी । दरवडेकरी खाणोरी । मैंद भोंदु परद्वारी । भुररेकरी चेटकी ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो मारेकरी, लुटारु, दरवडेखोर, घरांना खणून धन शोधणारा, भोंदू, परद्वारी वास करणारा, भुल पाडणारा व चेटुक करणारा असतो.
